The underlying category of the site <MATH_0001> has reasonable
``closure'' properties, i.e., given a scheme <MATH_0002> in it any locally closed
subscheme of <MATH_0003> is isomorphic to an object of <MATH_0004>.
Other such closure properties are: closed under fibre products of schemes,
taking countable disjoint unions,
taking finite type schemes over a given scheme, given an affine scheme
<MATH_0005> one can complete, localize, or take the quotient of <MATH_0006>
by an ideal while staying inside the category, etc.
On the other hand, for example arbitrary disjoint unions
of schemes in <MATH_0007> will take you outside of it.
